Review convergence at 80% of any total or per-stage iteration limit, or when the final stopping ratio exceeds 1. Checks use unrounded values. Picard uses the final unrelaxed permeability mismatch. Newton uses its recorded relative equation residual or absolute RHS-scaled floor; either passing test satisfies its stopping rule. Iteration statistics exclude reused fields and linear solves. Convergence does not establish mesh accuracy or benchmark qualification. Per-position convergence records are included in the CSV.
